package com.acme.shipping.label;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/**
 * Value object for carrier tracking numbers, e.g. AP-20261028-000042.
 */
public final class TrackingNumber {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter DAY = DateTimeFormatter.BASIC_ISO_DATE;
    private static final AtomicLong SEQUENCE = new AtomicLong();

    private final String value;

    private TrackingNumber(final String value) {
        this.value = value;
    }

    public static TrackingNumber next(final String prefix, final LocalDate day) {
        final long seq = SEQUENCE.incrementAndGet();
        return new TrackingNumber(prefix + "-" + DAY.format(day) + "-" + String.format("%06d", seq));
    }

    public static TrackingNumber of(final String value) {
        return new TrackingNumber(value.trim());
    }

    public String value() {
        return value;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return value;
    }

    static void resetSequenceForTests() {
        SEQUENCE.set(0);
    }
}
